name: Proprietary Body
source:
The story of a protagonist who falls back into his past to avoid losing any more of his livelihood – but ends up losing something far greater.

[From [url=https://venacavaexe.itch.io/proprietary-body]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了不再失去赖以为生的一切，主角不得不重操旧业、退回往昔的泥沼——然而最终，他却失去了远比生计更为宝贵的东西。

[摘自[url=https://venacavaexe.itch.io/proprietary-body]itch.io[/url]]
